ledger.net/minecraft/class_2535.field_11648:Lio: 1.20.2 keeps one protocol per direction: each direction's codec sits in its own channel attribute (Connection.ATTRIBUTE_SERVERBOUND_PROTOCOL / ATTRIBUTE_CLIENTBOUND_PROTOCOL) and switches by itself when a packet ending a phase passes the encoder or decoder; no attribute holds the one NetworkState 1.20.1's did
ledger.net/minecraft/class_8039.field_41877:Lio: 1.20.2's bundler handlers read the protocol codec of their own direction (see Connection); the side-indexed provider attribute 1.20.1 set beside the protocol is gone and nothing in 1.20.2 reads or writes one
ledger.net/minecraft/class_8039$class_8041: a 1.20.1 BundlerInfo.Provider answers per side; 1.20.2's providers are the per-direction codecs, asked without one (getBundlerInfo()), and no 1.20.2 code asks a mod's provider (the bundler handlers read the codec attribute): there is neither a side to pass a 1.20.1 implementation or lambda nor a caller to reach it (calls through the interface are bridged per side, instanceRedirects)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2547: 1.20.2 asks every packet listener its flow and protocol (Connection.setListener checks both); a class implementing only this 1.20.1 base interface declares neither (the specific play/login/status... interfaces supply them), and in 1.20.1 it could not be handed a packet either (Packet.apply casts the listener to the packet's own interface)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_7633: as PacketListener: a class implementing only TickablePacketListener declares no flow or protocol, which 1.20.2 requires of every listener it attaches
ledger.net/minecraft/class_6857: as PacketListener: a class implementing only ServerPacketListener declares no protocol, which 1.20.2 requires of every listener it attaches
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2602: 1.20.2's play listener must also answer play packets 1.20.2 added -- chunk batch start/finish (the finish answered by a ChunkBatchReceived acknowledgement the server's chunk sender waits for), StartConfiguration (hand the connection back to configuration) and PongResponse; a 1.20.1 implementation has no code for these protocol obligations and the interface gives no connection to answer on (its renamed methods are hooked, overrideHooks)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2602.method_11097(Ln: 1.20.2 spawns players with EntitySpawnS2CPacket through onEntitySpawn, which every implementation of the interface declares itself, so an implementation's onPlayerSpawn has no caller (calls are renamed to onEntitySpawn; on ClientPlayNetworkHandler subclasses player spawns are routed to it, overrideHooks)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2602.method_45728(Ln: 1.20.2 delivers the enabled features to the configuration listener (ClientConfigurationPacketListener.onFeatures) before any play listener exists and hands them to ClientPlayNetworkHandler's constructor; no play listener is sent them (calls reach the listener's own 1.20.1 method, CbNetClient.method_45728)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_634.method_45728(Lne: as ClientGamePacketListener.onFeatures: vanilla 1.20.2 never sends a play handler the features; the 1.20.1 body is put back for calls (CbNetClientPacketListenerBridge), an override is not called by vanilla
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2792: 1.20.2's play listener must also answer ChunkBatchReceived (the chunk sender's flow control), ConfigurationAcknowledged (the reconfiguration handshake) and QueryPing (moved in from the status listener); a 1.20.1 implementation has no code for these protocol obligations (its renamed methods are hooked, overrideHooks)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_2911: 1.20.2's login ends with the client's LoginAcknowledged, which onEnterConfiguration must answer by handing the connection to the configuration phase; a 1.20.1 login listener has no configuration phase to enter (1.20.1's server moved the connection straight to PLAY after LoginSuccess)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_3248.method_14384()V: an override: 1.20.2 split acceptPlayer into private steps (verifyLoginAndFinishConnectionSetup, finishLoginAndWaitForClient) and places the player after LoginAcknowledged, in the configuration phase; nothing overridable is left for it to stand for (calls run the 1.20.2 acceptance step, CbNet.method_14384)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_3248.method_14375(Lc: an override: 1.20.2 builds offline profiles only through the protected static createOfflineProfile(name), so no instance method is left to override (calls and super calls answer that static, CbNet.method_14375)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_634.method_11097(Lne: a ClientPlayNetworkHandler subclass overriding both onEntitySpawn and onPlayerSpawn: 1.20.2 sends player spawns to onEntitySpawn, which the subclass declares itself, so its onPlayerSpawn is not called (a subclass overriding only onPlayerSpawn has PLAYER spawns routed to it, overrideHooks; calls are renamed to onEntitySpawn)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_20870()Z: RealmsMainScreen.shouldShowPopup(): 1.20.1's main screen overlaid a purchase popup (trial / buy / close buttons, a teaser carousel) when the player had no Realm or opened it with its button; 1.20.2's has no such popup -- an empty account gets a no-Realms layout, a trial a separate popup screen -- and none of the state the answer was made of (popupOpenedByUser, showingPopup, hasFetchedServers) is left
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_35682(Z): RealmsMainScreen.setCreatedTrial(b): the flag hid that popup's trial button once the player had created a trial and stopped the data fetcher from offering it again; 1.20.2 has neither the popup nor the flag (its trial offer follows the service's trialsAvailable)
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_23765(Ln: RealmsMainScreen.updateTeaserImages(resources): filled the popup carousel's image list (teaserImages, from textures/gui/images); 1.20.2 has no carousel and no such list for it to fill
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_48171()V: RealmsMainScreen.addTopButtons(): a 1.20.1 init() step that added the pending-invites and news buttons and the popup's show button; 1.20.2's init builds another widget set through createHeader / createFooter / createLayout(LayoutState) and has no such step for a call or an override to stand for
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_48173()V: RealmsMainScreen.addMiddleButtons(): the 1.20.1 init() step that added the popup's trial, buy and close buttons; 1.20.2 has no popup and no such step
ledger.net/minecraft/class_4325.method_49287()V: RealmsMainScreen.addFooterButtons(): the 1.20.1 init() step that built the play / configure / renew / leave / back grid; 1.20.2's init creates those buttons itself and lays them out per LayoutState (createFooter), with no step a call or an override could stand for
